build_IndexPQFastScan: build a FAISS IndexPQFastScan index with 64 dimensions, 8 sub-vectors, and 4-bit encoding
train_IndexPQFastScan: train the IndexPQFastScan index on a numpy array of random float32 vectors
add_vectors_IndexPQFastScan: add a batch of float32 vectors to the trained IndexPQFastScan index
search_IndexPQFastScan: search the IndexPQFastScan index for the k nearest neighbors of query vectors
configure_nprobe_IndexPQFastScan: set the nprobe parameter on the IndexPQFastScan index to control search depth
